title: lachnagrostis plebeia
intro: Lachnagrostis plebeia, commonly known as the common blue grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to Australia and New Zealand, and is often found in dry, sandy soils. The health benefits of Lachnagrostis plebeia are largely anecdotal, but it is said to have anti-inflammatory properties and to be used in traditional medicine to treat a range of ailments, including fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Lachnagrostis plebeia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
